definitions: A strip of material, such as wood or metal, fastened to a surface to provide a grip, prevent slipping, or give support.
A projection or ridge on the sole of a shoe, especially a sports shoe, designed to provide traction.
A fitting, typically with two horns, around which a rope may be secured.
examples: The boat had several cleats for tying off lines.
He wore soccer cleats on the field.
The worker nailed a cleat to the wall for the shelf.
